request.provenance: Codex self-review of its own Task 005 S1 repair; not independent review

findings.title: Product tail diff can clear a complete legacy or snapshot cache while delivering only changed items
findings.evidence: src/services/codexHistorySyncService.js:1508-1510 builds an upsert-only partial diff for a bounded product tail against the client's full manifest. The same-tail case demonstrably yields zero upserts. android/app/src/main/java/com/termlink/app/codex/data/CodexConversationCacheStore.kt:1236-1249 deletes every old static item/conversation whenever provider_mode is not product_db, before its empty-upsert branch at 1257-1268 commits metadata only. A nonempty diff still contains only changed/new items, not every item in the old complete cache. The new productTailAtomicallyReplacesCompleteLegacyCache instrumentation test constructs a full one-item upsert directly and therefore does not cover this real manifest/diff path.
findings.consequence: Selecting a complete cached conversation with a canonical product row can erase its retained history (or leave only a changed tail) even when the product row's bounded tail is identical to the cache; the checkpoint can then describe an empty/truncated cache.
findings.recommendation: Make provider transition consume a complete bounded product tail or preserve compatible old items until proven replaced, and test the actual Gateway manifest/delta followed by Android commit for zero- and partial-upsert transitions.

findings.title: DB-only probe is spent by a transient conversation_not_active response
findings.evidence: CodexViewModel.kt:8669 marks productHistoryProbeSelectionKey before send and only clears it when send returns false. CodexViewModel.kt:9725-9789 handles conversation_not_active by resubscribing and scheduling the existing one-time activation retry, but does not clear that probe key. The scheduled maybeRequestHistorySync then computes productOnly=false and the unchanged complete cache returns through deferOrdinaryHistoryLaneForCompleteLocalCache at 8448.
findings.consequence: A request arriving before Gateway installs set_active can permanently skip the product DB-first reconciliation for that selection despite the existing activation retry path.
findings.recommendation: Release the probe token on the specific transient activation failure before its bounded retry, preserving the one-probe limit for ordinary terminal outcomes; add a focused selection/retry regression.
